nodes.label: «Создано агентом {agentName}» banner from NoteMeta.createdByAgent; «Понятно» writes null via acknowledgeAgentCreated (D-45, agent-created.spec)
newDocTarget(pathname): open notebook/folder, else last used notebook in the space (lib/lastNotebook.ts), else first; split «Новый документ» button, ⌥N (spec/05)
Tabs strip (TabStrip, fitTabs, «+N»), TabOverview (⌘⇧\), pinned tabs, «Недавно закрытые» (lib/closedTabs.ts), quiet tidy tidyTabs by settings.tabTidyDays (default 7)
Logout with unsent changes (unsentCount = sync outbox + REST queue): «Сначала отправить» / «Выйти»; account DB with notebook keys kept (endKeepingData); otherwise logout wipes local data

Session ended from another device (refresh 401): endKeepingData("revoked") clears tokens/keys from memory but keeps account DB, writes kv revoked record; login screen offers «Удалить данные с этого устройства» (revoked.spec)
Keys on web: master key only in memory, persisted encrypted by non-extractable WebCrypto AES key; notebook keys cached wrapped; only agent-mode notebook key goes to server (crypto.md §8)
Accessibility: a11y.spec.ts (axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA), keyboard.spec.ts, text.secondary for meaningful small text, focus-visible hover buttons, sr-only labels

Attachments in 1 MiB encrypted chunks (crypto.md §6): stored in IndexedDB first, uploaded in background (POST /v1/attachments, PUT …/chunks/:i); new note waits for POST /v1/docs; cover 2400 px, coverThumb 640 px

KDF parameters from prelogin validated before key derivation (auth/kdfBounds.ts, isSafeKdf, preloginResponseSchema, KDF_BOUNDS: argon2id13, ops 3–10, 64–256 MiB); derivePasswordKeys throws CryptoError unsafe_kdf (kdf-bounds.spec)
data/awarenessSanitize.ts: every foreign awareness update rebuilt; user.color only #rgb…#rrggbbaa, name ≤64 chars without control chars

Resilience to bad networks: service worker precaches shell and all /assets/* (cache-first); API timeout 15 s (chunk 60 s), GET retried twice; writes stay in ops/outbox; sync WebSocket closed if not open in 8 s (boot.spec)
nodes.rationale: Some networks hang new HTTPS connections on TLS handshake; page must not get stuck on the logo

nodes.label: public/boot-guard.js: on failed/stalled script or modulepreload, one automatic reload, then «Не удалось загрузить приложение» + «Повторить»; main.tsx calls __dsBootOk()
nodes.rationale: Separate file because CSP forbids inline scripts

nodes.label: Design-review polish (paper top bar, sentence-case headings) and motion respecting reduced-motion (MotionConfig reducedMotion="user")
SyncClient from @datascratch/shared/sync with DexieSyncStorage (src/data/syncStorage.ts: syncDocs, syncOutbox, batched getDocStates/setDocStates); DB migration v3→v4 moves old outbox
E2E also against real server (VITE_DS_SERVER_URL/E2E_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:8080; separate CI job with PostgreSQL)
All e2e run under production CSP (vite preview serves same headers); csp.spec fails on any securitypolicyviolation; web-image job checks headers via curl -I
Flexible layout: sidebar hidden by button/⌘\ (inert), full screen ⌘⇧F remembered per view (ds.focus.*), explicit tab close × / ⌥W, transition key from resolvedLocation (layout.spec)
FolderStrip above documents of notebook/folder with breadcrumbs; dismissable UnreadableNote banner «Часть изменений здесь пока не читается» (ds.unreadableDismissed)
Sidebar section «Блокноты» with folder tree of any depth (incl. agent-created folders), context menu, drag & drop (folders.spec)
src/lib/glyph.ts (iconGlyph, withIcon): iOS SF Symbol names shown as similar emoji; unknown names never shown as text
e2e images.spec: slash-menu picture, paste, second device decrypts both; top-bar button inserts two images, not into title, visible on phone
Images and files in a note: «/» → «Картинка»/«Файл», paste, drag; EditorHost.uploadAttachment encrypts in 1 MiB chunks (storeAttachment), resolveAttachment → blob:; works in minimal build (D-51)
«Вставить картинку» button in document top bar (InsertPicture in DocPage): several images, at cursor or at end, percent progress; visible on narrow screen / iPad Safari

Missing note key pauses the document (keyFor → null): nothing skipped, cursor stays; runtime calls client.keyAvailable(docId) when index changes; key_missing after 30 s; client.retrySkipped after key replacement
10 000 notes: virtualized lists/grid (@tanstack/react-virtual), structural sharing in refreshNotebook, memo cards, cached Intl formatters; title edit ~45 ms (was 8.5 s), cold start ~0.7 s
«Искать в этом списке» (ListFilter): filters current list by title and text (indexer.matching + MiniSearch); «/» or ⌘F focus, Esc clears (list-filter.spec)
Menu rows (renderItems): title with ellipsis and ✓ in fixed right column — MenuRow from @datascratch/ui (checked prop); menu-layout.spec
Notebook mode switch sends server its own key copy (serverNotebookKey), retried on network error (Safari «Load failed»); clear error message (notebook-keys.spec)
«Переместить в блокнот…»: moveNoteToNotebook rewraps note key, writes NoteMeta to new index, PATCH /v1/docs/:id, removes old entry (rollback on error); online only; warning for agent notebooks
New document registered via REST queue (POST /v1/docs) before subscribe (resubscribe if later); DocStore.open waits up to 15 s for docs row
New note title (spec/04): cursor in title, defaultNoteTitle «Заметка 26 октября 2026» via EditorHost.defaultTitle, EditorApi.focusTitle, setTitleOf; empty fresh note deleted on close (isNoteEmpty)

Opening a note writes nothing (no-writes-on-open.spec): syncNotebookMetaCopy only into synced index; indexer rejects empty extraction; default title and empty-note deletion only for notes created this session (lib/freshNotes.ts)
Editor mounted only when note has blocks or sync caught up and note is really empty (useNoteContentReady, runtime.isDocSynced); late-content.spec
nodes.rationale: Title loss 2026-10-26: editor wrote its empty title into a not-yet-synced note, demoting the real title to a paragraph

nodes.label: createNoteIndexer from shared (batches of 100, 0.4 s): titles, text, tasks, [[links]], tags → tasks/noteIndex tables + MiniSearch; syncNotebookMetaCopy copies notebook name/icon/color/space into notebook meta (document-model §3)

Canonical notebook key = server's (GET /v1/notebooks wrappedKey): reconcileNotebooks()/checkNotebookKeys compare after unwrapping, replace own key, rewrap note keys, reread index and upload snapshot with right key
nodes.rationale: A queued POST /notebooks answered 409 was treated as success, leaving two keys for one notebook

nodes.label: Client reconnects on browser offline event (WebSocket not always closed on network loss)

Offline-first device data in IndexedDB via Dexie (spec/10): ds-device (device id, non-extractable WebCrypto key, session) and ds-account-<userId> (docs, Yjs updates, outbox, REST ops queue, task and note index)
Packages of other streams: @datascratch/shared (core), @datascratch/web-editor (DatascratchEditor + EditorHost), @datascratch/ui and design-tokens
Pen palette collapses into round button at page edge (useUi.penPaletteCollapsed, showPalette={false}), as in iOS (pen-palette.spec)
settings.recoveryKeyConfirmed in account document: reminder visible/hidden on all devices; written to device first then moved to document (auth/recovery.ts)
«Создать новый ключ» with password on any device (POST /v1/auth/recovery-key, rotateRecoveryKey); old key stops working; security log GET /v1/me/security-events in «Устройства»
Recovery key screen after signup: copy, download, optional confirm (last 4 chars, «Пропустить»); key stored only on creating device, sealed by non-extractable device key (coordinator variant A)
Rich-paste images: EditorHost.fetchRemoteImage(url) (lib/remoteImage.ts) asks own server POST /fetch-image (D-52); CSP stays connect-src 'self'; failure leaves image as link
lib/safeMime.ts: decrypted blob: type only from allow-list (raster images, PDF, plain text); HTML/SVG/XML/code downloaded (openDecrypted); SVG saved as PNG (svgToPng)
nodes.rationale: blob: lives on our origin, so active content must never be rendered

nodes.label: src/lib/securityHeaders.ts — single source of CSP (script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval', connect-src 'self' + own WebSocket, frame-ancestors 'none', object-src 'none'), HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy; prod copy in infra/deploy/Caddyfile checked by unit test
VITE_DS_SERVER_URL: server address, defaults to the web app's own origin (one domain with API, infra/deploy)
restore(): each IndexedDB access limited to 4 s, whole path 6 s; login screen with explanation instead of endless logo; logo offers «Повторить»/«Войти заново» after 8 s (connect.spec)
Snapshot on leaving document after ≥30 edits (requestSnapshot, version history)
src/ layout: app (TanStack Router), auth, api (REST client), data (Dexie, Yjs, keys, ops queue, indexes), sync, domain, features, lib/ui/editor/i18n
StorageFullBanner «Хранилище браузера заполнено — изменения не сохраняются на устройстве» driven by SyncClient storage(ok)
Notes in SyncClient stored mode (storedDocs): Y.Doc only while held (DocStore.acquire/release, appendStored); 10 000 notes → 2 live docs, heap 72 MB vs 139 MB (perf.spec)
Service worker does not intercept server paths /v1/, /mcp, /oauth/, /.well-known/ (src/lib/serverPaths.ts)

pnpm typecheck / pnpm test (vitest: document model, sync storage, IndexedDB migration, i18n parity, /connect) / pnpm e2e (Playwright + mock server on :8787); CI web.yml

CSP not weakened: theme applied before paint by /theme-init.js (not inline), zod in jitless mode (no new Function probe)
Notebook name copy in index meta compared semantically (field order, null vs missing, empty space object) so web and iOS do not overwrite each other
Multi-tab token refresh under Web Locks; tab that finds session already refreshed takes it from IndexedDB (session.spec)

Guest route /s/:shareId#k=<key>: key never sent to server, removed from URL; guest session in memory only (POST /v1/shares/:id/guest), no IndexedDB; presence encrypted with document key

Full space isolation (D-48): favorites, recents, tabs, tasks, calendar, tags, search, trash per space (spaceOfNote, settings.activeTabBySpace, dailyNotebookBySpace, migrateSpaceSettings); «Переместить в пространство…»

Long sidebar sections (spec/12 §12.6): collapsible «Избранное»/«Блокноты»/«Теги» per space (useSpaceCollapsed), 7 rows + «Ещё N» (MoreList), tag tree by «/», «Все теги» dialog

D-53 web: device_revoked signal (REST 401 device_revoked via classifyApiFailure, sync close 4410) triggers wipeRevokedDevice() — account DB, session, recovery key, decrypted attachments, share keys erased; login screen explains
nodes.rationale: Only the server can tell revocation from an expired session; plain 401 unauthorized and network errors keep data (endKeepingData).

Incoming invitations (features/share/Invitations.tsx): sidebar «Приглашения N», accept / decline dialog, /invite/<id> link highlights invitation (grants no rights by itself)

✨ «Открыт ИИ-агентам» badge (AgentsBadge, SharedItem.agentsMode): participant sees owner opened shared notebook to AI agents; display only

Version history (HistoryDialog.tsx, authors.ts, lib/textDiff.ts): who changed each version (you, member email, agent, guest), «Версия» / «Изменения» word diff, «Восстановить» for owner and editor only
